description: This source file defines custom error handling, Azure AD token retrieval functions, and Azure SDK client initialization utilities for integrating Azure OpenAI services within a larger language model framework. It imports various external libraries like httpx and azure.identity, and references internal modules for caching, logging, and secret management.
